review.finding: NOT yet in round-6 scope, must add: the Stage-1-REJECT record invocation uses DOUBLE backslashes as line continuations (--force \\ at L559, --recorded-by spec-reviewer \\ at L560). In shell, \\ is an escaped literal backslash, NOT a continuation -- the newline terminates the command, silently dropping --recorded-by and --disposition. These are the ONLY two \\-terminated lines in the entire skills/iterate tree (every other multi-line command uses a single \). The dropped --disposition is exactly what the surrounding prose says must not be lost -- without it the durable record is a dispositionless not_run, indistinguishable from 'the cascade never ran'.
review.suggestion: Change both \\ to a single \. Add a test asserting no \\$ occurs in campaign-mode.md, since this class is invisible to every existing prose guard. MUST be added to round-6 fix scope.
